mermaid:
flowchart TB
    %% Style definitions
    classDef core fill:#b3d9ff,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    classDef asset fill:#90EE90,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    classDef terrain fill:#DEB887,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    classDef datagen fill:#DDA0DD,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    classDef support fill:#D3D3D3,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    
    %% Core Framework
    subgraph CoreFW["Core Framework"]
        CF["Core Framework"]:::core
        CS["Constraint System"]:::core
        NM["Node Management"]:::core
        SC["Scene Composition"]:::core
        
        CF --> CS
        CF --> NM
        CF --> SC
    end
    
    %% Asset Generation System
    subgraph AssetGen["Asset Generation System"]
        AG["Asset Generation"]:::asset
        ML["Materials Library"]:::asset
        OG["Object Generation"]:::asset
        LS["Lighting System"]:::asset
        PS["Placement System"]:::asset
        
        AG --> ML
        AG --> OG
        AG --> LS
        AG --> PS
    end
    
    %% Terrain Generation System
    subgraph TerrainGen["Terrain Generation System"]
        TG["Terrain Generation"]:::terrain
        MG["Mesh Generation"]:::terrain
        SP["Surface Processing"]:::terrain
        LF["Land Features"]:::terrain
        
        TG --> MG
        TG --> SP
        TG --> LF
    end
    
    %% Data Generation Pipeline
    subgraph DataGen["Data Generation Pipeline"]
        DG["Data Generation"]:::datagen
        JM["Job Management"]:::datagen
        RP["Rendering Pipeline"]:::datagen
        GT["Ground Truth Generation"]:::datagen
        
        DG --> JM
        DG --> RP
        DG --> GT
    end
    
    %% Supporting Systems
    subgraph Support["Supporting Systems"]
        SS["Supporting Systems"]:::support
        TU["Tools and Utilities"]:::support
        TF["Testing Framework"]:::support
        CM["Configuration Management"]:::support
        
        SS --> TU
        SS --> TF
        SS --> CM
    end
    
    %% External Dependencies
    BD[("Blender")]
    CUDA[("CUDA/GPU")]
    OGL[("OpenGL")]
    
    %% System Relationships
    CoreFW --> AssetGen
    CoreFW --> TerrainGen
    AssetGen --> DataGen
    TerrainGen --> DataGen
    Support --> CoreFW
    BD --> CoreFW
    CUDA --> DataGen
    OGL --> GT
    
    %% Click events
    click CF "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/core/"
    click CS "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/core/constraints/"
    click NM "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/core/nodes/"
    click SC "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/core/placement/"
    click TG "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/terrain/"
    click MG "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/terrain/mesher/"
    click SP "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/terrain/surface_kernel/"
    click LF "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/terrain/elements/"
    click AG "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/assets/"
    click ML "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/assets/materials/"
    click OG "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/assets/objects/"
    click LS "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/assets/lighting/"
    click PS "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/assets/placement/"
    click DG "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/datagen/"
    click JM "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/blob/main/infinigen/datagen/manage_jobs.py"
    click CM "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/datagen/configs/"
    click GT "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/datagen/customgt/"
    click TU "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/infinigen/tools/"
    click TF "https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen/tree/main/tests/"

    %% Legend
    subgraph Legend
        L1["Core Components"]:::core
        L2["Asset Generation"]:::asset
        L3["Terrain Generation"]:::terrain
        L4["Data Generation"]:::datagen
        L5["Support Systems"]:::support
    end
